## Customer-facing work that can be improved

::: {.ai-grid}
::: {.ai-card}
### Websites and forms

Build clear pages and structured forms that collect the information needed for the next step.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Payment systems

Connect payment status with the correct service, customer record, receipt, and follow-up workflow.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Inquiries and email drafts

Research the relevant record, prepare a direct response, and place the complete draft in front of a
responsible person for approval.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Outreach and contact research

Find relevant historical contacts, organize prior interactions, and prepare focused outreach without
sending it automatically.
:::
:::

::: {.ai-policy}
Customer communication always has an accountable owner. Drafting and research may be automatic,
but sending and changing customer records require approval.
:::
